Callout.Name: Car Alarm Nuisance
Callout.Message: Car alarm going off for hours, neighbours complaining.
Callout.Advisory: No persons near the vehicle, alarm faulty.

Script.Line: It is not my car. I am waiting for whoever owns it.
It has been going since last night and it is not my car.
I have called about it twice. Nobody has come.

Lines.Approach: It has been going two hours and the owner is away. Everybody on the street is awake.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
